name: churchfinder
description: ChurchFinder — Capacitor wrapper. index.html itself is still the whole app; everything here exists only to package it for iOS/Android. See supabase/README.md for the backend and capacitor/README.md for what this adds.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/index.html && cp -r vendor www/vendor
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
